about.title: About aeiou.now
about.one_liner: aeiou.now starts with two questions: what is this thing, and what happens to it in different places? Read the dates and rules first, then compare local practice, sources, and experiences from other people.
about.not_a: It is not a news headline with the wording changed, and it is not a pile of comments. Each page starts with information that can be checked; the discussion is for people who have actually dealt with it.
about.position_1: Check the dates, rules, and everyday practice around a topic
about.position_2: Put your place beside other places and see where the differences are
about.position_3: Follow a source back to the original material and see what has been checked
about.position_4: See which topics are being searched for or discussed now
about.position_5: Add what happened to you so the next person has a clearer starting point
about.flow_title: How a page is put together
about.flow_1: Start with a question people face now or every year
about.flow_2: Find official material and local explanations for each place
about.flow_3: Sort dates, rules, exceptions, and sources into separate facts
about.flow_4: Put the same question on one topic page
about.flow_5: Write local differences out instead of making one sentence stand in for everywhere
about.flow_6: Let readers ask questions and share what happened to them
about.flow_7: Keep search exposure separate from real interaction, and do not count bots as readers
about.flow_8: Use recent, popular, nearby, and event views to find the next page
about.flow_9: Show nearby places or events when a topic has useful local information
about.flow_10: Leave with a next step: check the rule, save the date, go somewhere, or share an experience
